Hi all — technical note and proposed execution plan. Attached: audit_export_20260728.csv (search results for the provided hash and nearby request metadata).

Summary of findings: the conversation (thread id: convo-8372-07-22) appears in the following places: streaming telemetry index (telemetry.v3.tokens), recent KV cache snapshots (read-only copies), and a single column in the audit export used for analytics. There are no backups containing the 1:1 content beyond the standard 30-day rolling hot backups (we will confirm).

Proposed removal steps (no downtime expected):
- Step 1: Create an isolated snapshot of all artifacts referencing convo-8372-07-22; encrypt and write to secure bucket (retention: 180 days) — this is the legal snapshot.
- Step 2: Remove entries from telemetry.v3.tokens and analytics index (atomic delete by message hash).
- Step 3: Purge any derived token caches and remove references from KV cache index.
- Step 4: Run verification jobs to assert hash no longer present across telemetry and exports (MD5/SHA sweep).
- Step 5: Produce a signed deletion_proof file and a brief runbook of executed commands.

ETA: assuming legal approval and no change requests, I can execute steps 1–4 in a 4-hour maintenance window today (start 13:00 PDT). I will provide deletion_proof_RQ-ORCHID-2142.txt once verification completes.
